title: From Employer Responsibility to Environmental Irresponsibility: Unintended Impacts of Social Insurance Law on Pollution Emissions
eligible_reason: Single adoption date and continuous treatment intensity. The 2011 Social Insurance Law is a national policy with policy = 1 for 2012-2013 and 0 for 2007-2011 for every firm; the identifying variation is the interaction policy_labor_ctn = policy x labor_ctn, where labor_ctn is the firm's log labor intensity in 2010 (continuous). The PSM-DiD in Table 3 and Table A4 uses a binary high-labor-intensity indicator (treat = labor) interacted with period = year >= 2012, which is still a single common adoption date. Figure 2 interacts year dummies with the continuous labor_ctn. Fails the at-least-two-adoption-dates and binary-treatment rules; most columns also add time-varying controls (size lev tang openness roa).
design_notes: Firm-year panel of Chinese manufacturing firms 2007-2013 from matched ASIF and ESR data (maindata.dta, desensitized). Outcomes COD and wastewater = log emission intensity (discharge / output value), also SO2 (appendix). Table 2: reghdfe COD/wastewater policy labor_ctn policy_labor_ctn [$X], absorb(id fixed_sector fixed_location) vce(cluster id), where fixed_sector = group(industry2_code year) and fixed_location = group(province_id year). Table 3: psmatch2 on 2010 characteristics (1, 3, 5 neighbours), then reghdfe y did treat period $X on the matched panel. Figure 2: ib2011.year i.year##c.labor_ctn $X. Tables 5-6: labor cost and financial outcomes on the same interaction (insurance_data.dta). Tables 7-10 and appendix: mechanisms and heterogeneity with the same structure.
modern_estimator_note: Full-text flags (ft_callaway, ft_de_chaisemartin, ft_goodman_bacon) presumably come from the literature discussion; no such estimator is in the code.

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date; continuous treatment intensity (policy x labor_ctn)
specs.outcome: COD (log COD emission intensity); wastewater at line 48
specs.treatment_var: policy_labor_ctn = policy * labor_ctn (with policy and labor_ctn as main effects)
specs.treatment_definition: policy = 1 for 2012-2013; labor_ctn = log(employees / assets) in 2010 (or 2007-2009 average)
specs.fe: id fixed_sector (industry2 x year) fixed_location (province x year)
specs.controls: none (columns 2 and 4, lines 42 and 51, add size lev tang openness roa)
specs.sample_condition: maindata.dta: manufacturing firms 2007-2013, above-scale, COD trimmed at 1/99, firms with both pre and post observations

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date (period = year >= 2012); time-varying controls; PSM-matched sample
specs.treatment_var: did = treat * period (treat = labor, high 2010 labor intensity within industry)
specs.treatment_definition: above-median 2010 labor intensity within 2-digit industry x post-2012
specs.weights: none (matched sample with _weight non-missing, common support)
specs.sample_condition: psmatch2 neighbours 1, 3, 5 on 2010 COD Leverage Tangibles ROA Export, caliper 0.005

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous intensity interacted with year dummies; single date; controls

data_files_note: README: final desensitized analysis dataset shipped; raw ASIF, ESR and NTSD microdata are confidential. Not described as synthetic. Results folder contains the authors' output tables (Table2.xls etc.) and logs.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Not a staggered design despite the ft_staggered flag.
